overview: This enum selects which attack voice line an animation notify or repeated attack plays.

Action.simple: Use the voice tied to this action.
Action.technical: Action is zero. UGameAnimNotify_PlayActionVoice defaults to it and maps it to voice kind 2 with VoiceIndex set to FixedVoicePatternIndex. PlayVoice case 2 takes the group from the current action through GetVoiceGroupRow and uses GetAttackVoiceIndex when that index is zero. A repeated attack with a continuous type of Action keeps kind 2 and retains the original index.

Weak.technical: Weak is the first entry in the shared attack-voice list. UGameAnimNotify_PlayActionVoice maps every non-Action value to voice kind 3 and passes Weak as the index. PlayVoice case 3 uses Index minus one on Id_CharacterVoiceGroup_Attack, and shikigami PlayVoice case 3 uses the same offset on Id_ShikigamiVoiceGroup_Attack.

Invalid.simple: Do not request a repeated-attack voice.
Invalid.technical: Invalid is the 255 sentinel. The base FGameCharacterAction::GetContinuousUseAttackVoiceType returns it, and the attack-base override also returns it when no AttackRow is available. PlayVoice explicitly skips a repeated-attack type of 255. Most exported Attack rows serialize Invalid for ContinuousUseAttackVoiceType.

notes: AttackDataTable writes these values into ContinuousUseAttackVoiceType. The shared PlayVoice code reads that field only for a repeated attack, then rewrites the voice kind and index before selecting a group.

The seven named non-Action values are a positional list and map to the WEAK, WEAK_MEDIUM, MEDIUM, HEAVY, FINISH, PROJECTILE, and CHARGE slots in exported CharacterVoiceGroup and ShikigamiVoiceGroup rows.
CP_170 overrides the continuous-use getter on its second Cursed EnergyAttack_1 start and reads the value from the phase and level aim-attack row.
